items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: It's like a professor Boeese, huh?

ctx.x: Ask him in the old days, when he first started picking a heart, did he play chords or single string or both?

Listen, he said when you first started playing, did you get a heart and pick, or just play chords all the time? Chords. Chords. You never picked? I tried. I used to pick, but they told me picking was too light for the band. They told me don't pick, you make chords. You see, I first learned on the mountain then. That was what made me just pick when I got out of the guitar. But I used to pick, and they told me they couldn't hear me. Don't pick, make chords. And that's why I got out of picking.
